notes.title: ✨Boss Rush Update!!✨
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37456276/7ef798d29539ca626605a3b11e347c31fe5c9af9.png[/img]

Hi there!

Today we bring the [b]✨Biggest Update✨[/b] yet for Mail Mole! With the 1.1.0 path, we are adding:

[h3]Pukat Rush Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] Beat all encounters against Pukat with only three hearts.
[*] Access it from a new Arcade Machine and check other players' times with the leaderboard.
[*] Unlock a Pukat Costume when completing it.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37456276/354802d6c305673fc97f7b0d8cff2285046dad03.gif[/img]

[h3]Gamepad Button Remapping[/h3]
[list]
[*] Remap the jump/dash/groundpound actions to different buttons on gamepad.
[*] The text will show the Xbox buttons names.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37456276/18c53ac98e5fb4180a220a4af51237d29dbf1606.gif[/img]

[h3]New Speedrun Options[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Skip Level Cinematics: skips the intro cinematic of each level to allow faster runs.
[*] Quick Restart: restart levels faster by pressing RS+LS.
[*] Speedrun Timer: allow milisecond timer to improve accuracy.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37456276/8df1f19c3cb82883cba9e482bd094e394f7c1c43.gif[/img]

If you want to join our community and talk to us directly, come to our [b]Discord Server[/b]!

[b]Join the server>>[url=discord.gg/Y4RRxxX]discord.gg/Y4RRxxX[/url]<<[/b]

And if you want to learn how to become the fastest mailmole in carrotland, check out our [b]tutorial videos on Twitter[/b]!

[b]Speedrun Tutorial>>[url=https://twitter.com/TalpaGames/status/1368162056122302465?s=20]https://twitter.com/TalpaGames/status/1368162056122302465?s=20[/url]<<[/b]

That's all! Thanks for playing Mail Mole :D

Talpa Devs

notes.title: Mail Mole Patch - 1.0.7 - Online Leaderboards
notes.notes:
[b]Features:[/b]
- Online Leaderboards accessible In the level selector of each cannon, the pause menu inside the level and the level recap menu. Available for everyone now.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
- King Rat's Lair leaderboard times were always 00:00, now they show up correctly.
- Talking to Batty on King Rat's Lair while getting the time medal no longer opens both menus at the same time.
- Leaderboard on Ancient Ruins is now fixed.
- Leaderboard no longer show 1ms diference with level times.
